verdict.rationale: A probe found a downloadable OpenAPI document at vercel.com/openapi.json, so the vendor does publish a machine-readable spec. Nothing shows that it covers AI Gateway endpoints such as Chat Completions or models, rather than only the general Vercel platform API. The JSON models endpoint is a machine-readable catalog, not an API spec. missing for 10: evidence that the OpenAPI spec covers AI Gateway endpoints, first-party docs pointing to a gateway-specific spec download, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
